# Abdul Aziz

> I enjoy taking messy problems and turning them into clean, working systems.

Abdul Aziz builds internal systems, AI agents and Shopify tools at ConfidenceClub in Sydney.

## Selected work

- Stock and purchase planning — an internal supply planning system that replaced Excel workbooks.
- Invoicing and order risk — a Shopify app for NDIS, Support at Home and business orders.
- Agents on live data — AI agents and pipelines that answer operational questions.
